title: Close dormant accounts
statementMd:
Mark as closed (`closed = 1`) all accounts that have no transactions after 2024-05-31, then count open accounts.

Expected columns: `open_accounts`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `UPDATE accounts SET closed = 1 WHERE id NOT IN (...)`.
solutionMd:
```sql
UPDATE accounts SET closed = 1 WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM transactions WHERE tx_date > '2024-05-31'); SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_accounts FROM accounts WHERE closed = 0;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
